title: MoveMap
user: Webcam-motion game makers and players who need to test whether a body gesture can be recognized reliably in a real room before mapping it to a game action.
smallest_useful_product: Local browser app: define 1–3 pose checkpoints, collect 10 examples, show live confidence/history, and export a JSON threshold profile.
success_measure: 60% of sessions complete a calibration and replay a 30-second test without a false trigger reported by the user.
constraints: On-device camera processing only; clear consent indicator; accessibility warning that movement is optional; no biometric identity inference.
